info.title: Dockit
info.description: An automatic Markdown documentation generator, fetch from .NET XML comment/metadata.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Generate Markdown documentation from a .NET assembly and its XML documentation file.
License: Under MIT.

options.name: --initial-level
options.description:
Set the base heading level of the generated
Markdown. The default is 1.

options.name: --scope-visibility
options.description:
Set the minimum accessibility to include: public,
protected, protected-internal, internal, private-
protected, private. The default is protected.

options.name: --editor-browsable-visibility
options.description:
Set the EditorBrowsable visibility to include:
normal, advanced, always. The default is
advanced.

options.name: --no-assembly-attributes
options.description:
Do not emit the assembly attribute csharp code
block. The version table remains.

options.name: --no-hash-link
options.description:
Do not emit local hash links to other items in the
generated Markdown.
